numbers.interpretation: Census value taken from the same row (same n) as the sampled arm; break-even = smallest n with sampled >= census among the n present; a log is eligible if its n=300 cell exists; censored (never) counts as > 300; median treats censored as +inf. Verdict uses m=4.

D15.summary_en: The sampled tracker is compared with a full count taken every 4 rounds (the 'census') in 24 logs. The smallest number of people per round at which the sampled list is at least as good is above 300 (or never reached on the grid up to 3000) in 54% of logs; the median break-even is >3000 people (for a census every 8 rounds: 8% above 300, median 300). The prediction needed at least 70% above 300, so it is not met.
D15.summary_zh: 在 24 个日志中，把抽样追踪器与每 4 轮一次的全量统计（普查）比较。抽样榜单第一次不差于普查所需的每轮人数，在 54% 的日志里高于 300（或在最多 3000 的网格内始终达不到）；追平所需人数的中位数是 >3000（对每 8 轮一次的普查：8% 高于 300，中位数 300）。预测要求至少 70% 高于 300，因此不成立。

numbers.interpretation: Primary arms are the c=10 ones (the statement says each person limited to 10 rows); 'loses < 0.05' = baseline NDCG minus private NDCG < 0.05; 'does NOT reach <0.05 in at least 50%' = share of logs with loss < 0.05 is below 50%; shares are over the logs eligible at that n. c=3 arms are in the tables only.

D16.summary_en: Central privacy (noise added once to the counts, each person limited to 10 rows) is compared with the same list without noise. With 10000 people per round and privacy level eps=2, the loss is below 0.05 NDCG in 11% of 9 logs; with 1000 people per round and eps=8 the loss is below 0.05 in 17% of 36 logs. The prediction needed at least 50% in the first case and fewer than 50% in the second, so it is not met.
D16.summary_zh: 中心化隐私（对计数加一次噪声，每人最多 10 条）与同样但无噪声的榜单比较。每轮 10000 人、隐私水平 eps=2 时，9 个日志中有 11% 的损失低于 0.05 NDCG；每轮 1000 人、eps=8 时，36 个日志中有 17% 的损失低于 0.05。预测要求前者至少 50%、后者不足 50%，因此不成立。

numbers.interpretation: Loss = baseline NDCG minus private NDCG; share over logs eligible at n=10000; criterion loss > 0.1 (strict).

D17.summary_en: Local privacy (each person randomises their own report, so the server never sees true counts) is compared with the same list without noise. With 10000 people per round and privacy level eps=4, the list loses more than 0.1 NDCG in 89% of 9 logs (mean loss 0.493, median 0.582). The prediction needed at least 50% of logs, so it is met.
D17.summary_zh: 本地隐私（每个人自己对汇报加噪声，服务器看不到真实计数）与同样但无噪声的榜单比较。每轮 10000 人、隐私水平 eps=4 时，9 个日志中有 89% 的榜单损失超过 0.1 NDCG（平均损失 0.493，中位数 0.582）。预测要求至少 50% 的日志，因此成立。

numbers.interpretation: Median over logs of each log's draw-mean of len100 and prec100 (athr:t=5, n=100); 'publishes a full 100 items' = mean published length 100 (>= 99.999999); smallest n reported both as first grid n where the median over logs is 100 and as the median of per-log smallest n.

D18.summary_en: A published item must have at least 5 reports in the running count. With 100 people per round, the median published list has 0.5 items (the full list would be 100) and 22% of the published items are truly in the top 100 (median over 26 logs). A full 100-item list is first reached at no n on the grid up to 3000. The prediction needed fewer than 50 items and at least 50% correct items, so it is not met.
D18.summary_zh: 每个发布的物品要求累计至少 5 次汇报。每轮 100 人时，发布榜单的中位长度是 0.5 个物品（完整榜单应为 100 个），其中 22% 的物品确实在真实前 100 名里（26 个日志的中位数）。能发满 100 个物品的最小规模：网格内（最多 3000）没有。预测要求长度少于 50 且准确率至少 50%，因此不成立。

numbers.interpretation: Verdict set = holdout_fresh + new_discovery + new_holdout logs at n=100 (fresh categories and new non-Amazon logs); equivalent age interpolated linearly between lags 0,1,2,3,4,6,8 from lag 0 upwards, 0 if baseline > lag 0 NDCG, 8 if baseline <= lag 8 NDCG (censored values enter the median as 0 / 8); interval [3, 6] inclusive.

D19.summary_en: The 'equivalent age' is how old a full count of all users would have to be to be as good as the sampled list: it is the lag at which the full count's NDCG equals the sampled list's NDCG (interpolated between lags 0 to 8, capped at 0 and 8). With 100 people per round, the median equivalent age over 7 fresh-category and new non-Amazon logs is 1.97 rounds (1 logs capped at 0, 0 capped at 8; median over all logs 3.31). The prediction needed a median between 3 and 6, so it is not met.
D19.summary_zh: “等效年龄”指：全量统计要旧到什么程度，才和抽样榜单一样好；即全量统计的 NDCG 等于抽样榜单 NDCG 时的滞后轮数（在 0 到 8 轮之间插值，并以 0 和 8 为上下限）。每轮 100 人时，7 个新类别和新的非 Amazon 日志的等效年龄中位数为 1.97 轮（1 个被截在 0，0 个被截在 8；全部日志的中位数 3.31）。预测要求中位数在 3 到 6 之间，因此不成立。

numbers.interpretation: n=100; best half-life = argmax of the draw-mean steady NDCG over the seven decay arms for each cutoff k (nd10, nd30, nd100, nd300); half-life inf is the longest; logs need all seven arms and four metrics.
numbers.note_median_best_h: half-life inf is coded as 16 for this median only

D20.summary_en: For each log we find the half-life (how fast old reports fade) that gives the best list at n=100 people per round, once for a top-10 list and once for a top-300 list. In 100% of 26 logs the best half-life for the top 10 is no longer than for the top 300, and it is strictly shorter in 42%. The prediction needed at least 60% and at least 25%, so it is met.
D20.summary_zh: 对每个日志，分别找出每轮 100 人时使前 10 名榜单和前 300 名榜单最好的半衰期（旧汇报衰减的速度）。在 26 个日志中，100% 的日志里前 10 名的最佳半衰期不长于前 300 名，42% 的日志里严格更短。预测要求分别至少 60% 和 25%，因此成立。

numbers.interpretation: ratio = steady NDCG of decay:h=2 at n divided by steady NDCG of fulldecay:h=2 (same row); k=100 uses nd100, k=10/30/300 the nd10/nd30/nd300 metrics; verdict = share of logs eligible at n=3000 with ratio < 0.95 (k=100) >= 70%; slope = OLS slope of (1 - ratio) on log10(n) (per tenfold increase of n).
numbers.reason: only 4 log(s) eligible at n=3000, at least 6 are needed

D21.summary_en: Not testable: only 4 log(s) eligible at n=3000, at least 6 are needed.
D21.summary_zh: 无法检验：n=3000 时只有 4 个日志可用，至少需要 6 个。

numbers.interpretation: Draw-mean nd100 per step; steady = mean over steps >= 8; burn-in = round number (= step, steps start at round 2) of the first step whose draw-mean is >= 0.9 x steady; median over logs; verdict at n=100: h=2 <= 3 and h=inf >= 4. Steps without a truth list (NaN, early rounds of a growing log) cannot be evaluated; a log whose first evaluated step is after round 3 and already at >= 90% of steady is left-censored (burn-in unobservable) and excluded and counted.

D22.summary_en: Burn-in is the first round at which the list's average NDCG reaches 90% of its steady level (steady = average over rounds 8 and later), at 100 people per round. With half-life 2 the median round is 6.0 (18 logs); with no forgetting (half-life infinite) it is 0.0 (12 logs); logs whose first evaluated round was already at 90% after round 3 are left out (8 and 14). The prediction needed at most 3 for half-life 2 and at least 4 without forgetting, so it is not met.
D22.summary_zh: 冷启动轮数是指榜单的平均 NDCG 第一次达到稳态水平（第 8 轮及以后的平均）90% 的那一轮，条件为每轮 100 人。半衰期为 2 时中位轮数是 6.0（18 个日志）；不遗忘（半衰期无穷大）时是 0.0（12 个日志）；第 3 轮之后首次评估时就已达 90% 的日志无法观察冷启动，被排除（分别 8 个和 14 个）。预测要求半衰期 2 不超过 3 轮、不遗忘至少 4 轮，因此不成立。

numbers.interpretation: Per log: per-round nd100 of decay:h=2 pooled over draws and steps >= 8; gap = mean - 10th percentile (linear interpolation); median over all logs eligible at that n; verdict: gap(n=300) <= 0.10 and gap(n=30) >= 0.15.

D23.summary_en: A 'bad round' is a round whose NDCG is in the worst 10% of rounds (steady rounds 8 and later, all draws pooled); we measure how far it sits below the average round. The median gap over logs is 0.121 NDCG at 300 people per round (24 logs) and 0.091 at 30 people per round (28 logs). The prediction needed at most 0.10 at n=300 and at least 0.15 at n=30, so it is not met.
D23.summary_zh: “糟糕的轮次”指 NDCG 处于最差 10% 的那些轮（第 8 轮及以后，合并所有重复），我们度量它比平均轮低多少。各日志差距的中位数：每轮 300 人时为 0.121 NDCG（24 个日志），每轮 30 人时为 0.091（28 个日志）。预测要求 n=300 时不超过 0.10、n=30 时至少 0.15，因此不成立。

numbers.interpretation: every row of stages cal and plan is one cell (a (log, n, n_win) present in both stages counts twice: independent draws); rho_pooled_merged averages such duplicates

D24.summary_en: Across 245 cells we compared the server's own score of its list (scored against the next round's reporter sample, no ground truth needed) with the true NDCG@100 (0 to 1, higher means closer to the real top 100). The Spearman rank correlation (1 = same ordering, 0 = unrelated) is 0.95 (median of the within-n correlations over 4 values of n; pooled over all n it is 0.94, inflated because both scores rise with n) against a bar of 0.7, so the prediction is MET. The self-score is on average 0.41 times the true score, and this ratio moves with n with rank correlation 0.66.
D24.summary_zh: 在 245 个单元中，我们把服务器对自己榜单的评分（用下一轮的汇报者样本打分，不需要真值）与真实 NDCG@100（0 到 1，越高越接近真实前 100）比较。秩相关系数（1 表示排序完全一致，0 表示无关）为 0.95（对 4 个 n 值分别计算后取中位数；不分 n 合并时为 0.94，因为两种评分都随 n 上升而被抬高），门槛为 0.7，因此预测成立。自评分平均是真实分数的 0.41 倍，这个比值与 n 的秩相关为 0.66。

numbers.interpretation: statement: rank correlation >= 0.5; prediction text: not met expected when |rho| < 0.5, so MET iff |rho_pooled| >= 0.5 (signed rho reported). 'Best-days stability' = per log max/min of the best days over n_win 45, 60, 90 (decay:days arms), correlated across logs with the log's mean churn; descriptive only, not used for the verdict

D25.summary_en: Across 124 cells at n=100 we compared how much the published top-100 changes from one round to the next (churn, share of the list replaced) with how far the list is behind a full count (NDCG of the full-count list minus NDCG of the baseline). Their Spearman rank correlation is 0.72; the statement needs a size of 0.5 or more, so it is MET (this study expected NOT MET). Against how much the best half-life in days differs between round counts, the log-level correlation is -0.22 over 29 logs.
D25.summary_zh: 在 n=100 的 124 个单元中，我们比较了榜单相邻两轮之间的变动（前 100 名被替换的比例）与榜单落后于全量统计的程度（全量榜单 NDCG 减基线 NDCG）。两者的秩相关系数为 0.72；命题要求绝对值不低于 0.5，因此结果为成立（本研究事先预期不成立）。与最佳天数半衰期随轮数变化的幅度相比，29 个日志上的相关系数为 -0.22。

numbers.interpretation: both clauses of the prediction text are required: MEDIAN over n in {300,1000,3000} (with >= 12 cells each) of the within-n rho >= 0.7 AND within-n rho(n=30) < 0.5; n_cells_n300plus here counts the n values used for the median, not cells

D26.summary_en: Split-half agreement is the overlap of the top-100 lists built from two random halves of the reporters. Its Spearman rank correlation (1 = same ordering) with the true NDCG@100 is 0.70 (median over the 1 value(s) of n in 300, 1000, 3000 that have at least 12 logs) (bar 0.7) and 0.76 at n=30 over 28 cells (must be below 0.5). The prediction is NOT MET.
D26.summary_zh: 半样本一致度是用随机分成的两半汇报者各自建出的前 100 名榜单的重合程度。它与真实 NDCG@100 的秩相关（1 表示排序一致）在 n 取 300、1000、3000 且日志数不少于 12 的 1 个取值上取中位数为 0.70（门槛 0.7），在 n=30 的 28 个单元上为 0.76（须低于 0.5）。预测不成立。

numbers.interpretation: 'each of 300, 400, 534, 700 days' read as a separate share per days value (all four must reach the required share); regret = best of the eight days arms minus that arm, steady NDCG@100 mean over draws; regret <= 0.01 inclusive; min_logs Amazon logs required. Figure data = d27_mean_regret.csv (no image written)

D27.summary_en: On 79 Amazon cells (log x round length of 3 to 9 months, 20 logs) we measured how much NDCG@100 each half-life in days loses against the best of the eight tried values (the regret). The share of cells with regret of at most 0.01 is 0.35 for 300 days, 0.63 for 400 days, 0.73 for 534 days, 0.44 for 700 days; every one must reach 0.8, so the prediction is NOT MET.
D27.summary_zh: 在 79 个 Amazon 单元（20 个日志，每轮 3 到 9 个月）上，我们计算了每个天数半衰期比八个候选值中的最佳者低多少 NDCG@100（遗憾值）。遗憾值不超过 0.01 的单元比例为：300 天 0.35，400 天 0.63，534 天 0.73，700 天 0.44；每一项都须达到 0.8，因此预测不成立。

numbers.interpretation: primary: best days among the eight decay:days arms at n=100 for n_win 45, 60, 90, ratio max/min <= 2 per log; eligible = non-Amazon logs with all three n_win and all eight arms; at least min_logs eligible logs required. Sensitivity: combined grid adds decay:h=0.25..8 arms converted to days (h x days per round)

D28.summary_en: For each of 8 non-Amazon logs we found the best half-life in days at 45, 60 and 90 rounds and divided the largest by the smallest. 8 logs (1.00) stay within a factor of 2 against a bar of 0.6, so the prediction is MET. The median ratio is 1.25 and the largest is 2.00; old logs 1.00, new logs 1.00.
D28.summary_zh: 对 8 个非 Amazon 日志，我们分别找出 45、60、90 轮时最佳的半衰期（按天），再用最大值除以最小值。有 8 个日志（1.00）的比值不超过 2 倍，门槛为 0.6，因此预测成立。比值中位数为 1.25，最大为 2.00；旧日志 1.00，新日志 1.00。

numbers.interpretation: best fixed = best of the seven decay:h arms (0.25..inf, includes the baseline h=2); gain = best fixed - baseline; clause 1 (non-Amazon, cells with gain >= 0.01): share with selfsel-base >= 0.5 x gain is >= 0.6; clause 2 (all non-Amazon cells): none with selfsel-base < -0.01; clause 3 (Amazon cells): share with selfsel-base < -0.01 >= 0.3. Share clauses need at least min_logs logs of the stratum and at least one qualifying cell; a harmful non-Amazon cell falsifies clause 2 at any size

D29.summary_en: On non-Amazon logs, among 23 cells where the best fixed half-life beats half-life 2 by 0.01 NDCG or more, the self-tuning server recovers at least half of that gain in 13 (0.57; bar 0.6), and it is worse than half-life 2 by more than 0.01 in 2 of 40 non-Amazon cells (must be 0). On Amazon logs it is that much worse in 38 of 84 cells (0.45; bar 0.3). The prediction is NOT MET.
D29.summary_zh: 在非 Amazon 日志上，最佳固定半衰期比半衰期 2 好 0.01 NDCG 以上的单元有 23 个，自调服务器在其中 13 个（0.57；门槛 0.6）追回了至少一半的收益；在 40 个非 Amazon 单元中，比半衰期 2 差 0.01 以上的有 2 个（须为 0）。在 Amazon 日志上，84 个单元中有 38 个（0.45；门槛 0.3）差这么多。预测不成立。

numbers.interpretation: arms = every arm in stage agg except the baseline, the oracle and census arms (fulldecay, cens, censold) and arms with |mean NDCG@100 diff| > 0.02; diff = arm minus baseline at n=100, mean over logs of the per-log steady mean; Spearman over arms between NDCG@100 and each other metric; a sign flip = opposite sign (a zero is not a flip) with |diff under NDCG@100| > 0.005; MET needs all four rho >= 0.9 and no flip under any metric; at least min_logs logs required

D30.summary_en: We ranked 23 aggregation arms by their mean NDCG@100 difference from the baseline over 29 logs at n=100, and repeated this with NDCG@10, NDCG@30, NDCG@300 and recall@100. The Spearman rank correlations (1 = same ordering) with the NDCG@100 ordering are 0.74 (nd10), 0.90 (nd30), 0.97 (nd300), 0.97 (rec100), all required to be at least 0.9. 1 arms flip sign with an NDCG@100 difference above 0.005 (must be 0), so the prediction is NOT MET.
D30.summary_zh: 我们在 n=100、29 个日志上，按各聚合方式相对基线的平均 NDCG@100 差值给 23 个方式排序，并用 NDCG@10、NDCG@30、NDCG@300 和 recall@100 重复。它们与 NDCG@100 排序的秩相关（1 表示排序一致）分别为 nd10 0.74，nd30 0.90，nd300 0.97，rec100 0.97，均须不低于 0.9。NDCG@100 差值绝对值大于 0.005 而符号反转的方式有 1 个（须为 0），因此预测不成立。
